tasks.label: CMake: Build Controller-Calibration Release
tasks.detail: Build with the Release CMake preset. The project CMake environment selects GNU STM32 14.3.1+st.2.

tasks.label: Flash Controller-Calibration via ST-LINK
tasks.detail: Flash and verify build/Release/ControllerCalibration.hex via ST-LINK/SWD, then reset. STM32CubeProgrammer is invoked by absolute path, not PATH.

tasks.label: Build + Flash Controller-Calibration (Release)
tasks.detail: Build Release, then flash and reset the target via ST-LINK.
